status: research; independent protocol and cryptographic review pending
construction: degree-one Shamir with Pedersen VSS commitments, composed with a private Groth16 local SGD relation
numeric_relation: fzknum-1.0.0 local step; full-state scalar, scale 16, ties-to-even, input range [-32,32], output [-80,80]
sharing_encoding: u=local_update+80 in BabyJubJub scalar field; weighted sum decoded without wrap, subtract 80*denominator, then ties-to-even division
data_commitment: D=(x+32+65*(y+32))*G+rd*H; x,y are private bounded witnesses
context_scalar: first 31 bytes of domain-separated SHA-256 context, little-endian; 248 bits constrained in circuit
h_derivation: SHA-256 domain FZKML/Pedersen/H/BabyJubJub/v1 plus u32le counter, reduced to y, lexicographically smaller x, clear cofactor; reject identity/G; ROM unknown-DL assumption, not an RFC 9380 suite
proof: BN254 Groth16; private x,y and commitment blindings; public context, parent w, C0 and D; local randomized research setup
authentication: Ed25519 strict verification; pinned issuer, client, recipient and durable-authority keys; trusted authenticated private delivery API
observer: coordinator sees credentials/pseudonyms, commitments, proofs, acknowledgments and authorized aggregate shares/sum; no per-client share or witness in coordinator API
corruption: privacy at most one colluding recipient plus honest-but-curious coordinator, conditioned on permitted aggregate; malicious inputs must satisfy proof, opening and authentication checks
availability: all three recipient availability receipts before freeze; release needs two distinct verified aggregate shares; earlier withholding aborts; no unconditional liveness guarantee
identity: one contribution per issuer-attested entity per round; no one-person, anonymous credential or real-world identity claim
release: durable possible-disclosure reservation before any aggregate share, immutable accepted root and one disclosure slot per parent, SQLite FULL/WAL trusted authority, durable cached release before delivery
unsupported: fewer than two available verified recipients
low-rank-only bound substituted for dense payload
malicious storage rollback or corrupted signing authority
